articles.title: IHC reserves ruling on maintainability of petitions alleging solitary confinement of PTI Founder, Bushra Bibi
articles.summary: The Islamabad High Court reserved its decision on maintainability of petitions challenging alleged solitary confinement of PTI founder Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi in Adiala Jail.

articles.title: IHC fixes June 29, for hearing PTI founder, Bushra Bibi Appeals in £190 Million case
articles.summary: The Islamabad High Court scheduled a hearing on June 29 for appeals filed by Imran Khan and his wife Bushra Bibi against their convictions in the £190 million case.
